questionnaire.name: SmartUrbanity - Your Experience on the Move - Public Transport
questionnaire.title: 4. Your experience on the move

sections.title: Welcome to Your Experience on the Move
sections.description:
This SmartUrbanity questionnaire asks about how you feel and what you experience while travelling, including walking, cycling, public transport, car, motorcycle and route quality. Your answers help identify barriers and opportunities for better urban mobility. Participation is voluntary and anonymous.

https://www.smarturbanity.com/about

sections.title: Public transport
sections.description: Questions about your experience using public transport.

questions.text: Do you use public transport for your daily travels at least once a week?

options.text: Yes
No

questions.text: How accessible and easy to use are the public transport stops (bus, tram, or train) on your route? (Think of steps, ramps, space)

options.text: Inaccessible
Difficult to access
Partially accessible
Mostly accessible
Completely accessible
I don't know

questions.text: Which specific barriers did you face while using public transport stops?

options.text: Stairs or level differences
Difficulty boarding or exiting the vehicle
Narrow or crowded spaces
Poor maintenance or damaged infrastructure
Poor accessibility for mobility needs
Lack of real-time information displays
Insufficient seating or shelter at stops
I don't face any specific barrier
Other

questions.text: How does the presence of other people make you feel during your trip?

options.text: Very uncomfortable
Slightly uncomfortable
Neutral / Indifferent
Mostly comfortable
Very comfortable

questions.text: How does the availability of working lifts, ramps, and step-free routes affect your ability to reach the transport stop?

options.text: I cannot reach the stop if no accessible route exists
I need assistance from another person to reach the stop
I can reach the stop, but it requires significant physical effort
I can reach the stop independently with some difficulty
I can reach the stop easily and independently

questions.text: How does the quality of the crossings (eg, lights, bridges, or tunnels) near the stop influence your sense of safety?

options.text: I avoid using this stop because the crossings feel unsafe
I often feel unsafe when crossing to reach the stop
I sometimes change my route to use crossings that feel safer
I generally feel safe, but I still need to be careful when crossing
I feel safe and well protected by the crossing design and traffic controls

questions.text: How does the schedule and frequency of public transport on your route affect your ability to rely on it?

options.text: The service is so infrequent or unreliable that it does not meet my basic travel needs
I can only use it for specific trips (e.g., work or school) because it is not frequent enough for flexible daily activities
I can use it for planned trips but it's not flexible enough for unplanned travel
The service is reliable, but I need to plan my schedule around arrival and departure times
The service is frequent enough that I can use it without planning

questions.text: To what extent does using public transport affect your sense of social comfort or personal image?

options.text: I would rather not be seen using public transport
I sometimes feel uncomfortable using public transport in certain social situations
I occasionally feel out of place or self-conscious when using this service in certain social situations
I don't feel that my choice of transport has any connection to my social standing or identity
I feel comfortable and confident using this mode of transport in social settings

questions.text: How stressful do you find unexpected delays or service disruptions during your trips?

options.text: Not stressful at all
Slightly stressful
Moderately stressful
Very stressful
Extremely stressful

questions.text: How do delays or unreliable service typically affect your travel behavior?

options.text: They do not affect my behavior
I leave earlier than necessary to avoid delays
I avoid relying on public transport for important trips
I sometimes change routes or travel times
I sometimes choose another transport mode instead
